channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Adam Silver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Adam Silver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dewayne Hankins on Adam Silver
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Dewayne Hankins:

“The league has been tremendously helpful. Adam [Silver] said it would be a failure [if the team moved]. We tend to agree with that. It's a challenging situation. It's very public and there's a lot of politicians who have made it a political football.”

Dewayne Hankins on Adam Silver, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Ballmer, Adam Silver
item.description:
“I think the reason the investigation took as long as it did and the idea that Steve Ballmer, who I’ve gotten to know and I know he’s a great guy, is standing by the punishment– there’s a reason that it’s happened all the way it has. And at the end of the day, Adam Silver had a job to do, and I think the punishment makes sense, and we all move forward.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Ballmer, Adam Silver, Sep 17, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Sophie Cunningham on Adam Silver
item.description:
Silver initiated the contact through Cunningham's agents.

“I have talked to Adam Silver a couple of times, and I think he's a great guy,”

Sophie Cunningham on Adam Silver, Sep 16, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Sophie Cunningham on Adam Silver, Cathy Engelbert
item.description:
“(Cathy Engelbert's) done a lot of good things,but with where our league is trying to go, I feel like you just want someone who also wants that. That's just a hard position to be in, in her shoes, us as players ― we always want more, more, more because we see how good it can be, but ... that's up to Adam Silver at the end of the day.”

Sophie Cunningham on Adam Silver, Cathy Engelbert, Aug 21, 2026. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Adam Silver
item.description:
Iguodala said of James' free agency frenzy.

“One thing I've learned in this tenure and working with the league and [commissioner] Adam [Silver], it's we got to do a better job of driving the positive narratives and the positive narrative is that he's [still] playing. Considering every time he wakes up, he's pissing somebody off because he'll drink red Gatorade as opposed to blue. I think it's just a great moment for the game.”

Andre Iguodala on Adam Silver, Jul 10, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Adam Silver
item.description:
Dan Gilbert on Adam Silver:

“I give him an A-minus. I think he's really good. You always got to have something to go for.”

Dan Gilbert on Adam Silver, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Adam Silver
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Adam Silver saying AI will eventually make calls in NBA games, such as out-of-bounds:

“I think that’s a great idea, because we have these coaching challenges and stoppage during games where five minutes of real time may go off, and we’re just sitting there.”

Kyle Kuzma on Adam Silver, May 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chus Bueno on Adam Silver, Mark Tatum
item.description:
said Bueno, andadmitted that everything is on the table:

“We are open to exploring, but this doesn’t mean it’s going to happen. There’s no time pressure for us or the NBA, but there’s a matter of momentum. Adam Silver said it, Mark Tatum said it, fragmentation is losing value. It would be better to maximise the opportunity together with the NBA”

Chus Bueno on Adam Silver, Mark Tatum, May 23, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Adam Silver
item.description:
“Maybe you don’t know this, but they look into every injury. This is nothing new. Probably because it’s been talked about, (Silver) felt the need to say something, but I’ve not been on a team where, when you have injuries, they don’t look at it. So, I don’t think it’s anything new.”

Doc Rivers on Adam Silver, Mar 25, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jorge Garbajosa on Adam Silver
item.description:
“We know it’s an interesting option for them,as it is for other clubs, as Adam Silver said the other day,”

Jorge Garbajosa on Adam Silver, Jan 23, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Adam Silver
item.description:
Charles Barkley:

“Well, let me say this. I think Adam Silver, who I love and respect, made a huge mistake. Listen, man. Quit screwing around with the All-Star game. Make it international against the US. All this you play a team, you play a team and all this other stuff...”

Charles Barkley on Adam Silver, Jan 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Adam Silver
item.description:
Enes Kanter:

“It's crazy to me. When they put us in the NBA bubble, Adam Silver himself said, 'This is basketball. Let’s talk about the problems that are happening in America.' Everyone was talking about the problems happening here, and Adam Silver and the NBA knew it wasn’t going to affect them. Money and business — more people watched NBA games in China than the American population last year. When I came out and started to talk about China’s human rights violations, they tried to silence me. It’s a shame — becauseAdam Silver is literally selling this league to the biggest dictatorship in the world. So that’s why I feel like he should step down as commissioner.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Adam Silver, Oct 27, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on David Stern, Adam Silver
item.description:
“What I would tell [commissioner] David Stern and then Adam [Silver] … you know how in soccer, for the Olympics it’s 21-and-under, 22-and-under, whatever it is? And then [FIFA] own the World Cup? And the World Cup’s a bigger event? I’m like, ‘give [the Olympics] our young kids. Do the same thing as soccer. Let the 21-and-under play for the Olympics, and then create our own international World Cup.’ … And they were like, ‘Well, FIBA. We got this contract with FIBA.’ Well that contract will expire. And them immediately — like, they wouldn’t tell me anything — but they were like, ‘Okay, we signed an extension with FIBA,'”

Mark Cuban on David Stern, Adam Silver, Jul 14, 2025. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Adam Silver
item.description:
“As far as the markets, I understand that there would be concern for how many people would watch because they’re smaller markets. But if we’re celebrating the game and we’re putting game above all, which is one of the things that Adam Silver said when he became commissioner, then it really shouldn’t matter. It really shouldn’t matter. “So I know that we’re going to do our very best to represent our city, our state at the best possible level. Thunder will do the same.”

Rick Carlisle on Adam Silver, Jun 4, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Adam Silver
item.description:
Charles Oakley:

“I would love to be there. I know the fans would love me to be there. I love the fans. They gave me a lot of cheer over the years, but it all started from the Commission[er Adam Silver], the owner and all other owners in the NBA,because he making it bad for all the teams in the league for something like this to be going on for eight years.”

Charles Oakley on Adam Silver, May 30, 2025. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: JJ Redick on Adam Silver
item.description:
JJ Redick on Adam Silver’s suggestion the league look into shortening quarters from 12 to 10 minutes:

“Not a fan. That’s not a good idea. We are the premier league, in the NBA. Why are we conforming to anyone else? It’s not a good idea.”

JJ Redick on Adam Silver, Jan 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gary Payton on Shawn Kemp, Detlef Schrempf, Adam Silver
item.description:
“I think Adam Silver has done a great job, along with the other ownerships, to bring this back. I know they want to bring in 2 expansion teams. It might look like (Las) Vegas and Seattle, and yes, I’m very involved with it. I’m very involved with this group. We have a lot of discussions about a lot of things, and I’m in Seattle all the time. “We’re very excited, and I think we’re going to get it back in the next three years. 2026, 2027, it might be that soon. I’m just very excited to get back involved. The role I’m going to play is going to be very big. The first thing I’m going to do is retire Shawn Kemp and Detlef Schrempf’s numbers.”

Gary Payton on Shawn Kemp, Detlef Schrempf, Adam Silver, Dec 25, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jorge Garbajosa on Adam Silver
item.description:
“We’ve all heard it. The rumors suggest they will do it on their own, butMr. Adam Silver made it very clear during a press conference at the Olympic Games – whatever we do in Europe, it will be hand in hand with FIBA,”

Jorge Garbajosa on Adam Silver, Nov 22, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Mark Tatum on Adam Silver
item.description:
At least that's what the Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum says.

“At the moment, we have no plans to expand. I'll tell you what the commissioner, Adam Silver, said: before we can think about the expansion, the collective bargaining agreement with the players must be completed, and we also want to complete the agreement with the television media, which we are currently negotiating,”

Mark Tatum on Adam Silver, Feb 15, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Adam Silver
item.description:
“I actually called [Adam Silver] and advocated for him to take marijuana off the banned substances list… It's the NBA, everybody does it. It's like wine.”

Kevin Durant on Adam Silver, Jul 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: David Zaslav on Adam Silver
item.description:
Discovery President David Zaslav hinted that it may look at an offer that includes a combination of its soon-to-come HBO Max/Discovery+ streaming service,as well as legacy cable network TNT, which currently airs games.

“When [NBA commissioner] Adam Silver thinks about the future, he thinks about it the same way that I do,”

David Zaslav on Adam Silver, Nov 4, 2022. Source: Deadline.

item.title: LeBron James on Adam Silver
item.description:
When asked a question about the NBA hosting the exhibition game in Las Vegas, James used the occasion to make a personal plea to commissioner Adam Silver, angling to be first in line to own the team if the league ever expands to Sin City.

“I would love to bring a team here at some point. That would be amazing. I know Adam is in Abu Dhabi right now, I believe,”

LeBron James on Adam Silver, Oct 6, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Louis Williams on Adam Silver
item.description:
“[NBA Commissioner] Adam [Silver] called me straight up and said ‘we’re going to give you 10 days quarantine because sh-t doesn’t look good.’ I said, ‘Yes sir’ and got off the phone,”

Louis Williams on Adam Silver, Jul 25, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Michele Roberts on Adam Silver
item.description:
Roberts told Yahoo Sports.

“I was prepared, I think Adam [Silver] would say he was prepared to shut down the season, [if] we found evidence that this was too dangerous, being away from home and the traveling. “[So] unequivocally, yes, for the obvious reason that we had it, right? If you don't play, if you don't work like everybody else, you don't get paid.”

Michele Roberts on Adam Silver, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Spike Lee on Adam Silver
item.description:
Lee said in a statement provided to Variety.

“I thank Commissioner Adam Silver, ESPN and ABC for giving me the opportunity to do what I love — sports and cinema. YA-DIG? SHO-NUFF.”

Spike Lee on Adam Silver, Jul 3, 2021. Source: Variety.com.

item.title: Las Vegas on Adam Silver
item.description:
Of her persistence in seeking an NBA franchise for Las Vegas, Goodman said,

“I think I’m more annoying to (Silver) than anybody else, … I know he sees the advantage of the Las Vegas area for an expansion team at the right time.”

Las Vegas on Adam Silver, Dec 22, 2020. Source: Las Vegas Review Journal.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Adam Silver
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on the NBA having 0 positive cases:

“There's absolutely no doubt that the NBA, under the leadership of Adam Silver, has done a magnificent job with being visionaries,looking at the big picture and looking at what unintended consequences may appear.”

Gregg Popovich on Adam Silver, Aug 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Adam Silver
item.description:
Rivers told the media in a Zoom call on Monday.

“And that goes to our leaders and our players and Adam Silver.”

Austin Rivers on Adam Silver, Jul 22, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Adam Silver
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Frank Vogel:

“I think the environment that Adam Silver and the league office have created could probably be one of the safer environments in the world. We’re optimistic that even with what’s happening in Florida, that hopefully we’ll be able to still finish the season.”

Frank Vogel on Adam Silver, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Adam Silver
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on the whole situation in Orlando with the NBA’s return:

“There’s definitely challenges, but I really want to commend Adam Silver and the league office … I’m comfortable with the format,I’m looking forward to competing in it with our guys.”

Frank Vogel on Adam Silver, Jul 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.
